summary: Examples using the bool filter in vars and in a when condition.
questions: How do I use a string variable as a condition in when?

answer_card.title: bool examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars:
  isbool: "{{ (a == b) | bool }}"
  otherbool: "{{ anothervar | bool }}"

# in a task
when: some_string_value | bool
```
